description: MANAGEMENT data class. Read the persisted books-to-MIS spreading reconciliation, not a new allocation run. Accounts view gives account-grain books plus adjustments equals MIS; adjustments view requires one account and pages its rule adjustments. Money is decimal-string rupees. Whole-run summary figures never change with account filters. The signed page_token is source-pinned, so restart at page 1 if source_changed. Raw warning context is withheld; known_stale and not_assessed are disclosure states, not freshness claims.

account_id.description: Required for adjustments view; an account in this entity and run.

account_name_patterns.description: Up to 10 case-insensitive account-name substrings; any match is retained.

page_size.description: Rows per source-pinned page: accounts default 25/max 100; adjustments default 50/max 200.

page_token.description: Signed continuation from the prior page; restart without it if source_changed.

view.description: accounts (default) or adjustments; adjustments requires account_id.

name: get_spreading_reconciliation
title: Read spreading reconciliation
